messages:
Renee: Pushing a small design pass for the autoscale row: aim is minimal height, clear guardrail explanations, and an obvious burst CTA. Prototype: https://intranet.redwood/protos/autoscale-row-compact :sparkles:

Omar: Suggestion: replace 'guardrail' wording with 'safety limits' in UI copy. It's more approachable for non-technical users. E.g., 'Active safety limits: max 50 replicas'.

Lin: Love that. Also, make the safety info expandable: small info link that opens inline details instead of a full modal. Keep it accessible: aria-controls + focus trap not needed if inline.

Maya: Burst CTA idea: instead of a toggle, use a compact button 'Request burst' which opens a mini panel showing cost and duration. Many users confuse automatic burst vs requested. Button wording clarifies it's an opt-in action.

Chris: Keyboard/a11y: 'Request burst' must be reachable in tab order before Save. Panel should be "role=\"dialog\" aria-modal=\"false\"" and focus should move into it on open and return on close.

Renee: On min/max inputs: show a tiny 'examples' link next to labels that opens a tooltip with a short sentence: 'Min=minimum nodes during low load. Max=upper cap during spikes.' Tooltips should show on focus.

Omar: Cost preview: inline chip 'Est. +$0.10/hr' that updates async. Debounce 300ms, cancel on new input, and use "role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"" for screen readers.

Lin: For the safety limits, include a 'why' link that points to docs and an inline explanation 'This prevents runaway costs and protects shared capacity.' Keep it concise.

Maya: Copy tweak: change 'SLO' label to 'Latency target' where possible, but keep 'SLO' in advanced docs. Users responded poorly to acronym-first labels in tests.

Chris: Dev note: telemetry should track Request burst opens and confirmations: `track('burst.request.open')`, `track('burst.request.confirm')`. Also track preset apply + undo.

Renee: Accessibility edge: when preset applies and reduces max, announce exact change: 'Latency target set to Low-latency. Maximum reduced from 100 to 50 replicas.' Use polite live region.

Omar: Visual: safety badge colors should include a textual label (e.g., 'Warning') for colorblind users. Icon + text is best.

Lin: I'll update Figma with 'Request burst' CTA, inline safety details, 'examples' tooltip, and Latency target copy. Will add a11y notes. Ping when frames up.

Maya: Thanks. If no objections I'll merge the compact row PR tomorrow. @Chris confirm telemetry bits? :rocket:

Chris: Confirmed. I'll add events and the debounce spec. Will coordinate with infra on cost endpoint cancellation.

Renee: Great work everyone. Small follow-up: make Save button say 'Save autoscale changes' when presets are applied to reduce ambiguity.
